ops.title: Keep the registered synckit debounce across cci mesh enable
ops.description: `cci mesh enable` writes `debounce = time.Second` (internal/mesh/helper.go:23) into ~/.cc-inbox/mesh/cci.json and runs `synckitd register`, which replaces ~/.config/synckit/manifests/cci.json byte for byte. A live tuning (root registered 5s on 2026-10-16) survives daemon restarts and is lost on the next enable. Make enable reuse Watch.Debounce from the registered manifest when it exists (manifest.Load; only os.ErrNotExist means unset) and move the first-enable default to 5s. Evidence: /tmp/host-relief-20261015-1939/cci-37-candidate-design.json, /tmp/host-relief-20261015-1939/cci-recon-batching-wire.json.

ops.text: cci mesh enable keeps an existing registered watch.debounce
a stale or unreadable registered manifest fails enable loudly, no fallback
helper_test.go covers both paths; README mesh enable row and CHANGELOG updated
